correctness.rationale: The all-set criterion for K_n minus C_n is credited to the full 2021 source. Deleting a selected vertex replaces its two adjacent gaps by their sum plus one. The two regimes give exact iff tests for whether removal fails, hence characterize inclusion-minimal sets. Transfer trace normalization by n/k yields all labeled coefficients. A 64-state potential with 136 exact integer inequalities proves the upper bound for all n and an explicit periodic gap family attains asymptotic density 4/7. Complete direct-graph enumeration for n=7 through 14, transfer counts through n=20, and 31 valid witness instances independently corroborate critical parts. Finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The complete 2021 article (Lemma 6) characterizes ordinary locating-dominating sets of K_n minus C_n and Theorem 2 their minimum size. It does not assert the inclusion-minimal cardinality polynomial or the sharp asymptotic 4/7 upper density. The former needs deletion-merge criteria plus a cyclic transfer trace, and the latter a 64-state integral potential and an infinite witness family. The 2010 upper locating-domination abstract offers general bounds, not a matching family-density theorem. Targeted indexed-literature comparisons found no equivalent, which does not prove universal priority.
residual_risks: Full text of the 2010 upper locating-domination paper was not read, despite accessible metadata and abstract.
Later or unindexed equivalent work and alternative terminology may remain undiscovered; failed search is not a novelty proof.
The prior 2021 gap criterion is a very close structural starting point, so the incremental classification should be judged together with its new enumerator and sharp density theorem, not alone.

value.rationale: The complete cardinality distribution of inclusion-minimal locating-dominating codes is natural for an irredundant detector problem. Unlike the previously known minimum size about 2n/5, the largest minimal code obeys a best-possible asymptotic density 4n/7. The new four-gap structural test, 27/64-state rational enumerator and sharp density proof provide exact infinite-family information rather than a routine finite case or code output.
